messages:
anna (ml): quick heads-up — kicking off a mini onboard eval for Heliotrope's LoRA merge on fusion-7b (int4). baseline = fp16 base; experiment = base+LoRA quantized to int4.
raj (ml): nice. what's in the eval slice?
anna (ml): ~2k prompts, multilingual (en/es/fr), invoice + email templates + a few long-context chats. Using customer tokenizer artifact.
leo (infra): infra note: running on dedicated int4 pool, batch=8, kv-cache kept. will increase replicas if noisy.
anna (ml): initial pass done — perplexity delta ~+0.7 overall. more concerning: Spanish outputs lose punctuation spacing and convert '€' to 'EUR' in some cases. small but customer-visible.
raj (ml): can you paste an example?
anna (ml): example: 
Input: "Factura por 1.200,50 EUR"
Output (baseline fp16): "Total: 1.200,50 €"
Output (merged int4+LoRA): "Total: 1200 EUR"
(so comma/period handling and currency symbol changed)
sarah (solutions): yikes. formatting like that will break parsing on their side. :eyes:
raj (ml): my first guess is tokenizer id remap after merge or merging change that affects byte/utf splits. run token-diff.
anna (ml): ran quick token diff: `python tools/token_diff.py --base out/baseline.txt --new out/merged.txt --top 12`
anna (ml): top mismatches: decimal separators ("," vs "." tokens), and `€` became two tokens that map to 'EUR' wordpieces.
leo (infra): also observed merged outputs are +2..+4 tokens on average for some prompts — could change stopping conditions.
raj (ml): two-pronged triage I propose: 1) re-run with customer's exact tokenizer artifact pinned (ensure vocab ids identical) 2) run with kv-cache cleared vs preserved to see if prefix caching interacts 3) re-quantize with symmetric 4-bit and compare logits on problematic tokens.
anna (ml): agree. I queued 1 and 2. job ids: ev-889123 (tokenizer-pin) and ev-889124 (kv-clear). eval-bot: eval queued — ev-889123 — https://ci.redwood.ai/ev/ev-889123 :white_check_mark:
raj (ml): I'll take #3 re-quantize test. ETA ~1.5h.
sarah (solutions): if tokenizer pin fixes it, we can ship a customer patch quickly and add a check to our LoRA merge checklist. would like a short summary for the customer later.
anna (ml): saved diffs to: `/mnt/heliotrope/quick_evals/1759998881/diffs.txt` and a small HTML side-by-side at `/mnt/heliotrope/quick_evals/1759998881/report.html`.
leo (infra): bumping replicas to 2 for these runs to reduce flakiness.
raj (ml): quick note — I'll also dump logits for the '€' and nearby tokens: `python tools/dump_token_logits.py --model merged --prompt-id 472 --tokens "€"`
anna (ml): perfect. if logits show consistent low prob for the correct token, it's likely quantization merge bias.
sarah (solutions): target: confirm root cause and recommended mitigation by EOD so I can update customer. :thumbsup:
raj (ml): updating thread once re-quantize/logit dumps are in.
anna (ml): thanks team. reactions: :eyes: from Sarah, :thumbsup: from Leo.
